name: 30° Dive CCIP
summary: Roll in from 8,000 ft, 30° dive, pickle at 4,500 ft
procedure: A/G master mode, CCIP on the stores page, correct station and program
Roll in, pipper short of the target and let it walk up
Pickle at release altitude — 4 G recovery, jink on egress

name: 45° Dive CCIP
summary: Steep dive from 12,000 ft, pickle at 6,500 ft
procedure: A/G master mode, CCIP
Steep roll-in — expect rapid speed build, throttle back as needed
Pickle at release altitude — 5 G recovery, do not press

name: Pop-up 4 nm
summary: Low run-in, pop at 4 nm to a 7,500 ft apex, 20° dive
procedure: A/G master mode, CCIP set before the IP
At the pop: pull, MAX power, check the apex altitude
Roll in, pipper on, pickle at release altitude

name: Level AUTO 18k (LGB)
summary: Straight and level, ATFLIR/LTD-R lase, AUTO release
procedure: A/G master mode, AUTO; TGP designate the target (TDC depress)
Wings level, pickle and hold — the jet releases at the cue
Lase (LTD/R ARM, trigger) from 8–10 s before impact until impact

name: Level AUTO 20k (JDAM)
summary: Straight and level inside the LAR, AUTO release on the target's coordinates
procedure: A/G master mode, JDAM page: target coordinates loaded, PP or TOO
Inside the LAR (IN RNG): wings level, pickle and hold until release

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low, AUTO release of high-drag bombs
procedure: High-drag / retarded bombs only
A/G master mode, AUTO, target designated
Level at 500 ft, pickle and hold through release

name: Maverick 8k level
summary: Medium altitude, lock and fire inside range
procedure: A/G master mode, Maverick selected and uncaged
Slew to the target, lock, confirm in range
Fire — keep the nose on until launch
